description.en: Same as CreateImage, but lets the caller specify a separate animation name instead of reusing the file name.
Name to assign the created image.
Image file name (without extension), loaded from data/tutorial/<fileName>.xa.
Animation name to use within the loaded image file.
Handle of the newly created image.

example.code:
// Load a game-over image with a distinct animation name
local hImg = CreateImageEx("gameOverImg", "gameover_<LG>", "gameover");
